attributes.name: search form placement relative to hero
attributes.definition: Where the search or booking form is positioned in relation to the hero section and its heading.

values.definition: Form sits in a separate band attached to the bottom edge of the hero, below the heading.
Form sits next to the hero heading in a side-by-side column arrangement.
Form is placed within the hero, stacked under or centered over the heading.
No search or booking form in or near the hero.

attributes.name: search form container treatment
attributes.definition: How the search or booking form is visually contained.

values.definition: Form is housed in a full-width strip with a dark background.
Form is housed in a compact card narrower than the hero content area.
Form is a bare bar with no distinct container.
